## entity.copy

Copies entities with their descendants (as the clipboard holds them): returns data for entity.paste, which makes new entities from it in this or another scene. Changes nothing.

Kind: `Query` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `scene` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: no · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/Commands/EntityCommands.cpp:288`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `entities` | array of string | yes |   | Entities to copy; those below another listed one are copied with it (entity IDs). Items: at least 1. |

## entity.dropToGround

Moves entities straight down until what they draw (with their children) rests on the surface below them: the mesh renderers of the scene, hit where their meshes are loaded (their bounds otherwise), their own left out. Entities listed below another listed one move with it; those with nothing below stay. One undo step (while playing it changes the running copy only). Returns {moved: \[ids\], unchanged: \[ids\]}.

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `scene` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/Commands/EntityCommands.cpp:554`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `entities` | array of string | yes |   | Entities to drop (entity IDs). Items: at least 1. |

<details>
<summary>Parameter schema of entity.dropToGround</summary>

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "entities": {
      "description": "Entities to drop (entity IDs)",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "type": "array"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "entities"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

## entity.duplicate

Duplicates entities with their descendants, each copy placed right after its original, in one undo step (while playing it changes the running copy only). References between the copied entities point at the copies. Copies get names unique among their siblings ('Crate' -&gt; 'Crate (1)'), so read names back from the returned IDs rather than finding copies by name. Returns the copies' IDs (entities, in the order given; id: the first).

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `scene` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/Commands/EntityCommands.cpp:220`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `entities` | array of string | no |   | Entities to duplicate (instead of entity); those below another listed one are copied with it (entity IDs). Items: at least 1. |
| `entity` | string | no |   | Entity to duplicate (entity ID). Pattern: `^[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,16}$`. |

<details>
<summary>Parameter schema of entity.duplicate</summary>

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "entities": {
      "description": "Entities to duplicate (instead of entity); those below another listed one are copied with it (entity IDs)",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "type": "array"
    },
    "entity": {
      "description": "Entity to duplicate (entity ID)",
```

## entity.find

IDs of the entities matching all given filters, in hierarchy order: exact name, tag, component type, and box: entities whose own world bounds (what they render, else their physical shape, else their origin) intersect the box. limit returns at most that many.

Kind: `Query` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `core`, `scene` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: no · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/Commands/EntityCommands.cpp:401`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `box` | object | no |   | A world-space box {min: \[x, y, z\], max: \[x, y, z\]}. |
| `box.max` | array of number | yes |   | Highest corner. Items: at least 3, at most 3. |
| `box.min` | array of number | yes |   | Lowest corner. Items: at least 3, at most 3. |
| `component` | string | no |   | Component type, e.g. &quot;PointLight&quot;. |
| `limit` | integer | no |   | Most entities returned (default: all). Value: at least `1`, at most `1048575`. |
| `name` | string | no |   | Exact entity name. |
| `tag` | string | no |   | Tag. |

## entity.get

An entity's name, parent, children and all component values, and inactive: {Component: {Property: reason}} for properties that have no effect in their component's state (e.g. a bloom threshold while Bloom is off; left out when none). With world: true also where it is in the world, decomposed from its world transform: world: {position, rotation: {euler (degrees, as the Inspector shows them), quaternion \[x, y, z, w\]}, scale}, and what it and its descendants take up: bounds: {min, max, size, center, pending} (what renders, skinned meshes in their pose; else physical shapes; else boxes around the entities; pending: a mesh still loading stood in as a box: ask again).

Kind: `Query` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `core`, `scene` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: no · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/Commands/EntityCommands.cpp:363`

```json
    "entity": {
```

## entity.paste

Creates entities from entity.copy's data, under a parent (default: the top level) at a position among its children (default: last), in one undo step (while playing it changes the running copy only). The new entities get fresh IDs; references between them point at each other, references to other entities stay. Top-level entities whose names their new siblings have get a number ('Crate' -&gt; 'Crate (1)'). Returns the IDs of the pasted top-level entities and warnings about data this build cannot read.

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `scene` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/Commands/EntityCommands.cpp:305`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | object | yes |   | What entity.copy returned in 'data': {&quot;Strata&quot;: {&quot;Format&quot;: &quot;Entities&quot;, ...}, &quot;Entities&quot;: \[...\]}. |
| `index` | integer | no |   | Position of the first pasted entity among the parent's children (default: last). Value: at least `0`, at most `2147483647`. |
| `parent` | string or null | no |   | Parent of the pasted entities; null or omitted for the top level (entity ID or null). |

## entity.setParent

Moves entities under another one, or to the top level, and/or reorders them among their siblings, in one undo step (while playing it changes the running copy only). With index, the entities end up at positions index, index + 1, ... among the parent's children, in the order given (also to reorder top-level entities or children of their current parent); without it, entities that change parent go last and the others stay where they are. Fails when the parent is one of the entities or below one.

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `scene` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/Commands/EntityCommands.cpp:459`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `entities` | array of string | no |   | Entities to move (instead of entity), in the order they end up in; those below another listed one move with it (entity IDs). Items: at least 1. |
| `entity` | string | no |   | Entity to move (entity ID). Pattern: `^[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,16}$`. |
| `index` | integer | no |   | Final position of the first entity among the parent's children (default: last). Value: at least `0`, at most `2147483647`. |
| `keepWorldTransform` | boolean | no |   | Keep the world-space placement of entities that change parent (default true). |
| `parent` | string or null | no |   | New parent; null or omitted for the top level (entity ID or null). |
